items.text: The legal age to buy, possess, grow or use cannabis in New Brunswick is 19. Adults may carry up to 30 g of dried cannabis (or equivalent) outside the home, and buy only from government-operated stores, in person or online.

You may use cannabis only in a private home, its backyard or property (with the owner's or occupant's consent), or at an occupied campsite. Public use isn't allowed. Using cannabis of any kind in or on a vehicle on a road or managed trail is banned, whether it's moving or not.
The legal drinking age is 19 under the Liquor Control Act.
